name: Bhubaneswar
title: Bhubaneswar: who is doing what about heat?
scope: Organisations and activities identified in public sources, read on 28 November 2026. It is not a complete list of everyone working on heat in Bhubaneswar, and no organisation was contacted.

orientation.text: Bhubaneswar, in a state long known for heatwave preparedness, launched an integrated heat and cooling plan in 2025 that links heat to the city's fast-growing demand for air conditioning, its lost water bodies and its building codes. It follows an earlier city heat action plan prepared with IRADe.

unknowns: Its role in carrying out the plan.
orgs.name: International Forum for Environment, Sustainability and Technology (iFOREST)
orgs.summary: Developed the city's Integrated Heat and Cooling Action Plan with the corporation.

orgs.outside: Its Singapore work is listed on Singapore's page.
orgs.name: Singapore-ETH Centre
orgs.summary: Collaborated with iFOREST on the city's heat and cooling plan.

orgs.name: Integrated Research and Action for Development (IRADe)
orgs.summary: Prepared an earlier Climate Adaptive Heat Action Plan for the city.

authorities.name: Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation
authorities.role: Launched the Integrated Heat and Cooling Action Plan in September 2025.

activities.evaluation: Not evaluated; temperature reductions are modelled projections.
activities.title: Integrated Heat and Cooling Action Plan (2025)
activities.desc: A plan linking heat and cooling demand: greening in all wards, strict use of the state's energy building codes, and projections of cooling demand to 2050.

activities.evaluation: Not evaluated in the sources read.
activities.title: Climate Adaptive Heat Action Plan
activities.desc: An earlier city heat action plan prepared by IRADe.

timeline.text: Integrated Heat and Cooling Action Plan launched.

gaps: The city corporation's seasonal heatwave measures (helplines, water, shelters) were reported in 2025 but the reports could not be read for this profile.

method_note: Sources were found by web search in English; local-language sources were not searched systematically. Where a source could not be read, nothing rests on it.
